justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_schema.py:1296-1300 keeps the three impl_source sources (computed/declarations/authored) and the absent case the brief required, so the shortening preserves the meaning while recovering the bytes.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no definition, so there is nothing to fork; it only shortens existing field descriptions in reckon/_schema.py, and a search for a second schema-serving path found none beyond gen_json_schema's callers.
